evals.prompt: 为这个架构决策写一份 ADR，包含 Context/Decision/Alternatives/Consequences/Verification/Supersession。
evals.expected_output: Applies the mandatory ADR structure with frontmatter Status=Proposed and explicit supersession statements.
assertions: Sets Status Proposed until maintainer approval

evals.prompt: 公共 API 变更需要 ADR，先核实真实源码里的接口签名再写候选 API。
evals.expected_output: Verifies framework API shapes against actual source before writing candidate signatures; flags maintainer decision points.
assertions: Reads real contracts before writing signatures

evals.prompt: ADR 写英文权威版加中文翻译，并更新两个 README 索引。
evals.expected_output: Writes en canonical + zh translation preserving identifiers and strength words; updates both README index tables; runs identifier-consistency diff.
assertions: Updates both README indexes and checks identifier parity

evals.prompt: 维护者需要决策清单：每个决策点给影响分析和推荐默认值。
evals.expected_output: Produces an impact-analysis table per decision point with recommended defaults and a numbered decision list; bakes decisions into the ADR on acceptance.
assertions: Records accepted decisions and adoption order

evals.prompt: 编写 SRS 需求条目。
审计需求到设计的可追踪性矩阵。
大规模修订通用技术文档的术语与结构。
evals.expected_output: Routes large document revision to ada-docs-revision.

evals.prompt: 梳理项目背景文档作为 SRS 前置输入。
evals.expected_output: Routes pre-SRS background authoring to ada-project-background-authoring.
